description: Using the Splunk Enterprise web interface, create a new alert that triggers when there are more than 5 failed SSH login attempts from the same source IP within a 5-minute window. First, log in to Splunk using username 'admin' and password 'SplunkAdmin1!'. Then navigate to Search & Reporting, enter the search query: index=security_logs "Failed password" | stats count by src_ip | where count > 5, and save it as an alert named 'Brute_Force_Detection'. Configure the alert to run every 5 minutes (cron schedule: */5 * * * *) and trigger when the number of results is greater than 0. The Splunk web interface is available at http://localhost:8000.
